focus: maintainability — derived manifests, md-generator pairing, changelog continuity, exclusion allowlist, and follow-on change cost

findingDetails.title: T032 lacks an executable complete derived-manifest regeneration contract
findingDetails.scopeProof: T022 lists leaf-manifest, mode-registry, hub-router, and command-metadata while T032 provides no command, artifact classification, or parity assertion.

claimAdjudication.claim: T032 can complete while stale derived routing artifacts still reference the deleted leaf.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked T022/T032 and all four JSON surfaces for a generator command or parity proof; none was specified.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: Some artifacts may be hand-maintained, but the plan does not classify them.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Name every artifact and provide exact regeneration/edit and zero-reference parity checks.

findingDetails.title: Promised deprecation changelog entry is not task-mapped
findingDetails.scopeProof: Spec requests an append-only deprecation entry, but Phase 2 tasks T022/T030 contain no changelog task/file; current changelog hits are historical.

claimAdjudication.claim: The plan may finish without creating the promised append-only deprecation record.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Searched all live sk-design changelog files and tasks for a named deprecation output; none found.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The decision record may be intended as the sole rationale, but the spec explicitly promises a changelog entry.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Add a named append-only changelog task/file and link it from the summary/decision record.

findingDetails.title: Live-surface exclusion allowlist is prose-only and not reproducible
findingDetails.scopeProof: Plan defines git ls-files minus prose categories and T010 says freeze in scratch, but no format, path, hash/count, or reuse command is specified.

claimAdjudication.claim: Inventory and final residue verification can drift because the exclusion policy and frozen allowlist are not reproducibly defined.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked scope, task, and decision-record text for a machine-readable allowlist and hash/count assertion; none was present.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: A manually maintained scratch file may exist later, but its format and reuse are undefined.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Pin a machine-readable manifest, generation/hash command, and exact reuse in the final sweep.

findingDetails.title: Residue gate misses camelCase/uppercase identifiers
findingDetails.scopeProof: Prior variant sweep reproduced live shared identifiers not matched by plan regex.

findingDetails.title: Inventory omits live mcp-tooling discovery fixtures
findingDetails.scopeProof: Prior fixture sweep found three tracked snapshots outside the plan inventory.

findingDetails.title: NFR-S01 lacks explicit env/path/token residue assertion
findingDetails.scopeProof: Prior security sweep found no independent assertion for retired env/path/token identifiers.

findingDetails.title: Claimed checklist items have no pinned evidence
findingDetails.scopeProof: Prior traceability audit found checked rows without evidence links and later evidence rows unchecked.
